dedupe_keys.name: large scale laboratory observations of transient wave dissipation from idealized mangrove forest

description: Large-scale laboratory observations of transient wave dissipation from idealized mangrove forest is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Daniel Cox, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). Starting in November 2020, a team of researchers from Oregon State University and the Naval Academy compiled a series of experiments at the Oregon State University, O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory in the Large Wave Flume with full-scale physical mangrove models, to determine the dampening effects of mangrove trees on waves. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-qte8-w226. Keywords: Tsunamis, waves, mangroves, dampening, wave height, green infrastructure. Published 2021-08-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
